en.title: amino acids injection (PROSOL): Table 2 and Table 2 give different instructions for one patient
en.summary: Table 2 reads “1 month to 1 year of age”. Table 2 reads “1 to 10 years of age”. Example: A child aged exactly 1 year matches both rows. A child aged exactly 1 month, and a child aged 10 to 11 years, match no row. The text is in this label.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: low; careful reading of the whole label usually resolves it. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.
